title: Brain-state-resolved consistency of corticospinal responses to TMS
title_zh: 基于脑状态的经颅磁刺激下皮层脊髓反应一致性
abstract: BACKGROUND: An important feature of motor-evoked potential (MEP) responses to transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) over the primary motor cortex (M1) is their substantial trial-to-trial variability. Ongoing brain activity at the time of TMS, such as the power and phase of the sensorimotor mu rhythm, influences MEP amplitude. It is unclear to what extent these endogenous brain states also shape the consistency of MEP amplitude across trials. OBJECTIVES: We investigated trial-to-trial variability of MEP amplitude as a function of pre-stimulus mu dynamics. METHODS: Twenty-nine healthy participants received 1200 single TMS pulses over the left M1 during simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) recording; 10 participants completed two sessions to assess inter-session reproducibility. Trials were stratified based on pre-stimulus mu power, phase, and interhemispheric M1-M1 functional connectivity. Brain-state-resolved MEP variability was quantified using the coefficient of variation (CV) within subsets of trials defined by similar pre-stimulus mu dynamics. RESULTS: Trial subsets characterized by high mu power were associated with reduced MEP variability, indicating more consistent corticospinal output. In contrast, mu phase did not significantly influence MEP variability at the group level. Mu power group-level effects were reproducible across sessions in an exploratory test-retest analysis and across experimental sites. CONCLUSIONS: We show that inter-trial consistency of MEP amplitude reflects a structured, brain-state-dependent feature of the sensorimotor network. These findings contribute to our mechanistic understanding of trial-to-trial variability in TMS-evoked responses. This may provide a basis for future TMS approaches aimed at reducing response variability and improving the consistency of neuromodulatory effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：在对初级运动皮层（M1）进行经颅磁刺激（TMS）时，运动诱发电位（MEP）反应的一个重要特征是其显著的试次间变异性。TMS时刻的持续脑活动，例如感觉运动区mu节律的功率和相位，都会影响MEP幅度。目前尚不清楚这些内源性脑状态在多大程度上也会塑造MEP幅度在试次间的一致性。目标：我们研究了预刺激mu动力学对MEP幅度试次间变异性的影响。方法：29名健康受试者在左侧M1接受1200次单次TMS脉冲，同时记录脑电（EEG）；10名受试者完成两次会话以评估会间可重复性。根据预刺激mu功率、相位和两侧M1-M1功能连接性对试次进行分层。使用相同预刺激mu动力学定义的试次子集内的变异系数（CV）量化脑状态分辨的MEP变异性。结果：高mu功率的试次子集与MEP变异性降低相关，表明皮层脊髓输出更一致。相反，mu相位在组水平上并未显著影响MEP变异性。mu功率的组水平效应在探索性测试-重测分析和不同实验地点均可重复。结论：我们表明MEP幅度的试次间一致性反映了感觉运动网络的结构化、脑状态相关特征。这些发现有助于我们对TMS诱发反应试次间变异性的机制理解，并可能为未来旨在降低响应变异性、提高神经调节效应一致性的TMS方法提供基础。
